name: Fenna loaded at the mill fork · third person
expression: async()=>{const walk=async(x,z)=>{const r=Realm.test.move(x,z);if(!r.ok)throw Error(r.error);const start=performance.now();while(Realm.test.path.length){if(performance.now()-start>45000)throw Error('Walk timeout');await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));}};const key=k=>{document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:k,bubbles:true}));document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{key:k,bubbles:true}));};Realm.test.setTime(16);document.querySelector('[data-rpg="camera"][data-id="adventure"]').click();key('e');document.querySelector('[data-rpg="earth-confirm"]').click();await walk(0,10);await walk(7,5);key('e');document.querySelector('[data-rpg="rain-accept"]').click();document.querySelector('#rpg-close').click();await walk(7,4.2);Realm.test.view({yaw:-.15,elevation:.28,distance:8.2});Realm.test.render();return{story:Realm.state.adventure.earthStory,projection:Realm.diagnostics.camera.projection};}
